content:
# Interface Monitoring / System Health

Useful commands include:

show interfaces terse

show interfaces

show interfaces extensive

Monitor for:

- Link state
- Errors
- Drops
- CRC errors
- Traffic rate
- Negotiated speed
- Duplex behavior

---

Useful health checks may include:

show system uptime

show system processes extensive

show system storage

show chassis hardware

show chassis alarms

show system alarms

Exact command support may vary by Junos version.

---
